reuse.why: Changes only the existing isNonWorkingDay predicate that every holiday-aware path already calls, reusing monthUtils.dayFromDate.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the MM-DD match is one extra lookup inside the single predicate.

placement.why: The holiday-matching rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines it.

scope.why: A three-line change to the predicate, one test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small, commented, and every consumer gets the new format for free.

bypasses_abstraction.where: None; the change is inside isNonWorkingDay.
